lines.text: Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball GT are all owned by
Funimation, Toei Animation, Fuji TV and Ak—

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: This is my people's sacred battleground.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: We flew over an hour for *this*?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: It looks exactly the same as everywhere else on this godforsaken rock!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, maybe so, but I can't quite be a racist against a race that doesn't EXIST.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Dirty, money-grubbing Clorfors. Tried to clorf me right out of my money.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Blew those little bastards up is what I did.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. I didn’t know we were starting.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Looks like someone's going to be missing this.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Ooh, that looks like it hurts a *lot*.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: It's a healing tank. This'll bring the idiot back to full strength.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Heh heh, ow, it hurts to laugh.'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Heh heh, ow. Heh heh, ow. Heh heh, ow.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: It'll take a while though. This is the only other model the ship has. And it's kind of an old one.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: What happened with the newer model?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: What, did it have an opinion?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Eat me. Now both of you...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I’ve got body armor for you.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You know, Gohan, it just occurred to me.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, I mean, it feels like we’ve been here for, like, a year.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But we've only been here for six days.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey, by the way, don’t I look like that one guy that Vegeta landed with back on Earth? What was his name again?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey Vegeta, what was that one guy's name?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh right. Good old "God damn it Nappa".

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin, we should probably focus on finding a way to use the Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, there’s always Little Green, but…

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Plus, I think I sense some hostility.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Fine, fine, I’ll go get him. Enjoy your company.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Try not to get yourself killed, God forbid you make me happy.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You know, you seem like you’re in a bad mood. Maybe you should take a nap.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Maybe YOU should— eh, actually, that sounds good.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You keep guard out here. Make sure not to go too far; I like my meat shields within bullet-blocking distance.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I didn’t think bullets could hurt you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Heh-heh, ow. Heh-heh, ow. Heh-heh, ow. Heh-heh—'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, hey, King Kai. I’m in a healing pod.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I noticed, I wasn’t paying attention. What the hell?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, when I got down I ran into some really weird guys.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: One was really big and muscly; he went down real easy.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Then these two guys double teamed me. One of them took it really hard in the back.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: The other didn’t seem that interested, so he went and brought this really horny guy!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: It’s George Takei. Somehow we made this into a three-way.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: How many arms do you think we’re up to?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I think we’re up to twenty-four.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Tell me. Have you ever heard of the planet “Vegeta”?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Funny, because I expect to hear the same from the next person when I ask them about *Namek*.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, was that your nose? That was your nose!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I’ve had a worse time, you know. It’s not often I dirty my own hands with this sort of grunt work.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: There’s always a certain amount of satisfaction I get out of doing it myself.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Ahh, it is kind of funny, isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Aha I’m, I’m laughing at something else actually.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Remember the little Namekian you passed on the way to Guru’s?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: On his way to the humans with the password.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: By now he’s probably already there and they’re about to summon the Dragon. Haha.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Yeah. If I had to guess your biggest mistake, it would be not stopping him.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Why aren’t the Ginyus showing up?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Haha, you should see the look on your face!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, I’m just kidding, it’s me, Krillin!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Haha, you’re killing me, Little Green!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Now come on, we gotta go summon the Dragon.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'You know, it’s not so bad. I mean sure, I’ve seen more people die than most people my age.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Or really, most people in general. Then again, I don’t really know anyone my own age.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'My best friends are a 26-year-old dwarf and a giant green alien who constantly hits me.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Still, better than my Dad. At least they’re AROUND!'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wow, you made it in no time at all!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Yeah. Little Green here was on his way back from Guru’s.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: He said he can help us summon the Dragon!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Great! I’ll go get Vegeta and—

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: No, no, no, see, that’s the best part! We’re not gonna TELL Vegeta!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: That sounds like a very dangerous idea that could very easily backfire.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, we can either take the wishes for ourselves or give ‘em to Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And I’m not gonna lie - I don’t think he’s dedicated to Team Three Star at all.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You know, I’ve been meaning to tell you. That name...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, why didn’t you tell me sooner?! I thought it was stupid from the beginning but nobody said anything!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Let’s just go summon the Dragon and go home.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Hurr-hrr, first immortality... then the bitches…

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: We did it! Again! For real this time, though!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Now we just can have Little Green summon the Dragon, and we’ll finally have our wish!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Dammit, stop speaking gibberish *and summon the*—!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Holy crap, your Dragon’s on steroids.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: All right! We can finally get our wish!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: The Dragon says he’ll give ya three.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait a minute, we get three wishes? That's awesome!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Stop screwing around and wish these idiots off my planet!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Holy crap, I can hear a voice in my head!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Is it telling you my name is Dende?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hush, Little Green! The voice speaks to me!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: This is King Kai. Wish these guys back to life before I kill myself.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: All right, Little Green! Use our first wish to bring our friends back to life!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Porunga can only bring back one person at a time.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: King Kai, he says it can only bring one person back at a—

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Which means one of us gets left behind.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I guess we should ask Yamcha what he thinks.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Listen - if you wish *me* back, then that wishes *Kami* back.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Then you can use THOSE Dragon Balls to wish these morons back.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Which leaves us with two more wishes!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Little Green! Wish our friend Piccolo back to life, and then with our next wish, bring him to Namek!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Hold on a minute, don’t do that, that is a terrible i—

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh, so it’s a sort of monkey’s paw. You have to be careful with the hubris in your wishes.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Wah, urk - Jesus, I overslept. It’s already night.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: For the first time since I got here... ...on a planet with three suns.
Alarm clock clip sourced from Merrie Melodies short "Farm Frolics" (1941)

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So, what do we do with the third wish?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, if nobody else has any ideas, I want my three foot—

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I’m never gonna get my hoagie.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: But first - you are going to give me my wish for immortality, or I will Snap. His. *Neck*!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait! He’s the only one who can ask the Dragon to grant wishes!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And I’ve got nothing to lose!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: GOOD ANSWER! Now get to wishing!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: 'I feel that they have finally summoned the dragon. Would be a real dick move to die right now.'

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: No. It’s dead. And that means Guru is, too.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I’m so sorry for your loss.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: That doesn’t matter! Don’t you understand?!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: If it didn’t me grant my wish, then I’m not immortal!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And Freeza’s going to…! G-going to…

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Ohohoho nohoho, don’t mind me. By all means...

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Mr. Popo, what are you watering?

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: I'm not getting rid of it.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Are you kidding? That sh*t’s great for my glaucoma.

segments.title: Hmph. Racist.
segments.quote: Hmph. Racist. / Well, maybe so, but I can't quite be a racist against a race that doesn't EXIST. Like the Clorfors.

segments.title: Are You Okay? I'm Fine!
segments.quote: Ooh, that looks like it hurts a *lot*. Are you okay? / I'm fine! / Good to know. Yoink!

segments.title: Now Both of You... STRIP
segments.quote: Eat me. Now both of you... STRIP.

segments.title: Three-Way Call with George Takei
segments.quote: It's George Takei. Somehow we made this into a three-way. / Oh myyy~! / *CALL*! THREE-WAY CALL!

segments.title: That, or the Purple Lipstick
segments.quote: The Earthlings have the password. ... If I had to guess your biggest mistake, it would be not stopping him. That, or the purple lipstick.

segments.title: WHY ARE THEY DEAD?!
segments.quote: Why aren't the Ginyus showing up?! Oh, they're dead. WHY ARE THEY DEAD?!

segments.title: At Least They're AROUND!
segments.quote: Still, better than my Dad. At least they're AROUND! ... Huh... where did that come from?

segments.title: He Is on Namek
segments.quote: He is on Namek. / Wait, where is he? / On Namek. / You dumbass! ... NERRRRRD!!

segments.title: A Planet with Three Suns
segments.quote: For the first time since I got here... ...on a planet with three suns. / Oh you MOTHERF—UCKERS!!

segments.title: Thwartin' My Plans?!
segments.quote: What're you doing?! / Nothin' much. / Thwartin' my plans?! / ...Yes. / ...I'M GONNA F*CKING KILL YOU!

segments.title: Give Me Some Ideas
segments.quote: Ohohoho nohoho, don't mind me. By all means... *give me some ideas*.
